# QnALog 1.6.7

## Highlights

- Files that QnALog deletes for you (cleaning blank short recordings, clearing the diagnostic log) now follow Obsidian's "Deleted files" setting instead of always going to the system trash. The confirmation text says so.
- Release assets (`main.js`, `manifest.json`, `styles.css`) now carry GitHub build provenance attestations, so the download can be verified against this repository.
- Code and style cleanup for the community plugin scorecard: removed `Array.prototype.at()` calls and redundant type assertions, replaced `:has()`, `!important`, `display: contents` and `column-gap` patterns in the stylesheet. The layout is unchanged.

## User impact

The settings schema and API key storage are unchanged. No notes are rewritten. The only visible change is where deleted cleanup files go, which now depends on your Obsidian "Deleted files" setting.
